usamo-usamo-2019-01.prompt:
A function $f \colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfies
$$\underbrace{f(f(\dots f}_{f(n) \text{ times}}(n)\dots)) = \frac{n^2}{f(f(n))}$$
for all positive integers $n$. What are all possible values of $f(1000)$?
usamo-usamo-2019-01.answer: Every even positive integer. The solutions are exactly the $f$ that fix all odd numbers and are involutions on the even numbers: $f$ is injective, fixes odd $n$ by induction (divisors of $n^2$ are odd), and minimality along the orbit forces $f(f(n)) = n$.

usamo-usamo-2019-03.prompt: Let $K$ be the set of positive integers not containing the decimal digit $7$. Determine all polynomials $f(x)$ with nonnegative integer coefficients such that $f(x) \in K$ for all $x \in K$.
usamo-usamo-2019-03.answer: $f(x) = k$, $f(x) = 10^e x$, and $f(x) = 10^e x + k$, where $k \in K$, $e \ge 0$ and $k < 10^e$. Each monomial of $f$ must itself work (substitute $10^e x$); $cx$ works only for $c = 10^e$ (some power of $c$ starts with $7$); $cx^d$ with $d \ge 2$ fails via $x \mapsto 10x + 3$.

usamo-usamo-2019-06.prompt:
Find all polynomials $P$ with real coefficients such that
$$\frac{P(x)}{yz} + \frac{P(y)}{zx} + \frac{P(z)}{xy} = P(x - y) + P(y - z) + P(z - x)$$
for all nonzero real numbers $x$, $y$, $z$ obeying $2xyz = x + y + z$.
usamo-usamo-2019-06.answer: $P(x) = c(x^2 + 3)$ for any real $c$. The cleared identity extends to all complex points of $2xyz = x + y + z$; $(t, -t, 0)$ shows $P$ is even, and $\left(x, \frac{i}{\sqrt2}, -\frac{i}{\sqrt2}\right)$ shows a second difference of $P$ is constant, so $\deg P \le 2$.
